description: Verify that OfferService carries two entries when DUT is configured with two instances
approach:
[Objective]
OfferService carries two entries when DUT is configured with two instances.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message (OfferService / Subscribe Ack / Nack). The harness captures it and validates the asserted property byte-precisely.

[Pass condition]
The asserted property holds on the wire.

[Fail condition]
Fail_<state> per the listed verdicts; Fail_timeout if no qualifying SD message arrived.

verdicts.Pass: OfferService carries two distinct-instance entries — normal
verdicts.Fail_offer_entries: OfferService entries not two distinct instances
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
